column1: # ZAP baseline scan rules (Milestone 17), one per line: id<TAB>FAIL|IGNORE<TAB>why.
# The scan runs with -I: warnings are reported but only the FAIL rules below fail CI, so a new
# informational rule in a newer ZAP release can't turn the build red on its own.

column3: (Anti-clickjacking header) frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options must be set
(Sensitive Information in URL) e.g. a form falling back to GET; every form posts
(Content Security Policy header not set) proxy.ts sets it on every page
(CSP: style-src unsafe-inline) React style attributes need it; scripts stay strict. See apps/web/src/lib/csp.ts
(Authentication Request Identified) informational: the sign-in form
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) forms are sent by fetch with the X-CSRF-Token header and an Origin check (ARCHITECTURE.md section 5); a form posted without scripts changes nothing
(Non-Storable Content) informational: signed-in pages must not be cached
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing) no cross-origin isolation is needed; COOP same-origin is set
